contributionBanner.title: Your contribution matters
contributionBanner.body: Your data — always anonymised, used with your consent — is part of something bigger. Kind is operating as an open-access citizen science platform supporting scientific publications from everyday health exploration. You can see how your data is used and download your data at any time.
